faqs.question: What services does aiNOW provide?
faqs.answer: aiNOW is an AI marketing agency in Tbilisi, Georgia. Services: AI content and video production, web and mobile development, AI chatbots, business automation, AI characters and influencers, graphic design, SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (LLM SEO).

faqs.question: Where is aiNOW located?
faqs.answer: aiNOW is based in Tbilisi, Georgia. We serve clients across Georgia, Armenia, and Azerbaijan.

faqs.question: What languages does aiNOW work in?
faqs.answer: Georgian, English, and Russian. The website is available in four languages: Georgian (default), English, Russian, German.

faqs.question: How do I start a project with aiNOW?
faqs.answer: Email CONTACT@aiNOW.GE or visit https://ainow.ge/start. Tell us what you need — we scope the project and send a fixed-price quote. Once you approve and pay, we start building. An NDA can be signed separately on request.

faqs.question: What is LLM SEO or Generative Engine Optimization?
faqs.answer: LLM SEO (also called GEO) makes a brand citable by ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity. The work covers entity optimization, schema markup, FAQ blocks, llms.txt, /.well-known/ai.txt, and citation building. aiNOW offers this service at https://ainow.ge/services/llm-seo.

faqs.question: How does aiNOW charge for projects?
faqs.answer: aiNOW works on fixed-price contracts only. The client pays, aiNOW delivers the service. No equity, no revenue share. Scope and price are agreed up front in a fixed-price quote before work starts. Pricing: AI marketing from 500 GEL/mo, chatbot from 150 GEL/mo, websites from 2000 GEL one-time.

faqs.question: What technology stack does aiNOW use?
faqs.answer: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS for web. Native and cross-platform stacks for mobile. Python and Node.js for AI workflows. Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini, and open-source models for AI features.

faqs.question: How do I contact aiNOW?
faqs.answer: Email: CONTACT@aiNOW.GE. Telegram: https://t.me/ainow_ge. Contact form: https://ainow.ge/contact.
